name: BrightEdge Autopilot Page Publisher
description: Updates title, meta description and H1 based on BrightEdge Autopilot recommendations.
project_description:
Introduction 
 The BrightEdge Autopilot Page Publisher is a comprehensive Drupal module that seamlessly integrates with the BrightEdge SEO platform to enable automated content optimisation and SEO management. This module provides a powerful bridge between your Drupal content management system and BrightEdge's advanced SEO recommendations, allowing for real-time updates of page titles, meta descriptions, H1 tags, and other critical SEO elements through both manual interface, BrightEdge Platform and BrightEdge Chrome Extension as well.

 The module enhances your content editing experience with live Google SERP previews and provides a secure bridge to update content meta information via BrightEdge Platform and Chrome extension, making it an essential tool for SEO professionals and content managers who want to leverage BrightEdge's AI-powered SEO recommendations directly within their Drupal workflow.

 Features 
 

 🎯 Core SEO Management 

- Live Google SERP Preview : Real-time preview of how your content will appear in search results

- Integrated Meta Tag Editing : Seamless editing of SEO titles and meta descriptions within content forms

- H1 Tag Optimization : Update page headings based on BrightEdge recommendations

- XPath Element Support : Advanced content targeting using XPath selectors for precise element updates

 ⚙️ Advanced Features 
 - BrightEdge Chrome Extension : Provides an integration to update content changes, meta information directly through the Chrome extension.

 Post Installation 
 1. Configure User Permissions :

 - Ensure your content editors have appropriate permissions to edit content types with metatag fields

 2. Set Up BrightEdge Integration :

 - Create or select a user account with content editing permissions

 - Submit the user's credentials to BrightEdge platform for API access

 3. Test the Integration :

 - Edit any content type with BrightEdge Platoform

 - You'll see the new "Brightedge" fieldset with SEO title and meta description fields

 - Use the live SERP preview to see how your content will appear in search results

 Additional Requirements 
 Dependencies 
 - Metatag Module : Required for meta tag field functionality

- Node Module : Required for content entity support

- Token Module : Required for token replacement functionality

 System Requirements 
 - Drupal Version : Compatible with Drupal 8, 9, 10, and 11

- PHP Version : PHP 7.4 or higher recommended

- Database : MySQL 5.7+ or PostgreSQL 10+

 BrightEdge Platform Requirements 
 - BrightEdge Account : Active BrightEdge platform subscription

- User Permissions : Content editing permissions for the configured user

 Support & Documentation 
 For detailed documentation, references, and support, visit the [BrightEdge platform]( https://www.brightedge.com/ ) or contact BrightEdge Technologies for enterprise support options.
